## Crawlability

### robots.txt (if hosting documentation site)

```
User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://ryanw.eu/sitemap.xml
```

### Canonical URLs

All documentation should reference canonical URLs:

- Repository: `https://github.com/ryan-winkler/ryanwinkler`
- Website: `https://ryanw.eu`
- Machine-readable: `https://ryanw.eu/llms.txt`

---

## Link Building

### Internal Links

- All documents cross-reference related content
- Clear navigation from README to all major sections
- Breadcrumb-style navigation in subdirectories

### External Links (Backlinks)

- Personal website (ryanw.eu) links to repository
- LinkedIn profile links to repository
- X/Twitter profile bio includes repository link
- Wellfound profile links to repository
- Clay profile links to repository

### Community Links

- Listed in awesome-product-management (potential)
- Referenced in product management communities
- Shared in relevant Slack/Discord communities

---

## Content Optimization

### Headings Hierarchy

- H1: Main title (README.md)
- H2: Major sections
- H3: Subsections
- Clear, keyword-rich headings throughout

### Content Structure

- Clear introduction with value proposition
- Scannable content with bullet points
- Code examples and templates
- Real-world examples and case studies
- Clear calls-to-action (Connect, Resources)

### Keyword Density

- Natural keyword usage (not stuffed)
- Keywords in headings, first paragraph, throughout content
- Semantic variations and related terms
- Long-tail keywords in specific documents

---

## GitHub-Specific Optimization

### Repository Name

- `ryanwinkler` — Personal brand, memorable, searchable

### Repository Description

- Keyword-rich, clear value proposition
- Under 160 characters for search results

### Topics/Tags

- 10-15 relevant topics
- Mix of broad and specific terms
- Aligned with GitHub's topic taxonomy

### README.md

- Comprehensive, well-structured
- Clear navigation
- Visual elements (diagrams, structure)
- Links to all major content

### File Organization

- Logical directory structure
- Descriptive file names
- README files in all directories
- Consistent naming conventions

## Maintenance

### Regular Updates

- Keep NOW.md current
- Add new insights and runbooks
- Update CHANGELOG.md
- Refresh examples with recent work

### Content Freshness

- GitHub shows last commit date
- Regular commits signal active maintenance
- Update timestamps in documents

### Link Maintenance

- Check for broken links quarterly
- Update external references
- Ensure all profiles are current
